Grade Descriptions for Cambridge IGCSE Physics 0625 for examination 2023-25 1
Grade Descriptions for Cambridge IGCSE Physics 0625
What are grade descriptions?
Grade descriptions describe the level of performance typically demonstrated by
candidates achieving the different grades awarded for a qualification. For Cambridge
IGCSEs, they describe performance at three levels - grades ‘F’, ‘C’ and ‘A’.
Grade descriptions sit alongside other key documents that illustrate examination
standards, including:
• the syllabus, which presents what students should be taught over a course of study
and explains how this is assessed
• the specimen assessment materials, which illustrate the structure of the assessment
